data.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

Implement merge-story-branch.sh to make T3 tests pass.

## Acceptance Criteria (from DD2)

- Accepts `<story-branch> <story-id>` positional args
- Merges story branch into current branch with --no-ff
- Commit message via: `printf 'Merge %s\n\nDSO-Story-Merge: %s' "$STORY_BRANCH" "$STORY_ID"`
- Trailer key is `DSO-Story-Merge:` (machine-readable story ID) — NOT `DSO-Story:` which apply-attribution-trailers.sh uses for parent title on task commits
- Missing story branch → exit non-zero with error
- No conflict-queue check in this script (orchestrator enforces in-memory in SKILL.md Phase F)

## Files to create
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-story-branch.sh (executable via chmod +x)

## Script header comment to include
# DSO-Story-Merge trailer: machine-readable story ID for this merge commit.
# Distinct from DSO-Story: written by apply-attribution-trailers.sh (parent title on task commits).
# check-sprint-trailer.sh does NOT fire on session-branch merge commits — no modification needed there.

## Notes
- ShellCheck clean
- No external dependencies beyond git
data.title: GREEN: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-story-branch.sh — merge story branch with DSO-Story-Merge trailer
